paragraphs: Broadcom Inc. is an American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products. Broadcom's product offerings serve the data center, networking, software, broadband, wireless, storage, and industrial markets. As of 2026, Broadcom is one of the largest companies globally.

In December 2024, Broadcom became the 12th company to surpass a $1 trillion market cap. In April 2026, Broadcom surpassed a $2 trillion market cap, becoming the sixth company in history to do so. As of 2025, some 58% of Broadcom's revenue came from its semiconductor-based products and 42% from its infrastructure software products and services.

Tan Hock Eng is the company's president and CEO. The company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Avago Technologies Limited changed its name to Broadcom to acquire Broadcom Corporation in January 2016. Avago's ticker symbol AVGO now represents the merged entity. The Broadcom Corporation ticker symbol BRCM was retired. Initially the merged entity was known as Broadcom Limited, before assuming the current name in November 2017.
In October 2019, the European Union issued an interim antitrust order against Broadcom concerning anticompetitive business practices which allegedly violate European Union competition law.
In May 2022, Broadcom announced an agreement to acquire VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at $69 billion. The acquisition was closed on November 22, 2023.

people.name: Hock E. Tan
people.title: President, Chief Executive Officer and Director
people.bio: Has served as President and Chief Executive Officer since March 2006. Previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Integrated Circuit Systems, Inc. from 1999 until its acquisition in 2005.
people.quote: Hock E. Tan has served as our President and Chief Executive Officer since March 2006.

credit.author: Greg Bezat, d/b/a Bezat Video Group

people.name: Kirsten M. Spears
people.title: Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer since December 2020, after serving as Principal Accounting Officer and Vice President and Corporate Controller. Previously served as Vice President and Corporate Controller at LSI Corporation from 2007 until its acquisition in 2014.
people.quote: Kirsten M. Spears has served as our Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer since December 2020.

people.name: Mark D. Brazeal
people.title: Chief Legal and Corporate Affairs Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Legal and Corporate Affairs Officer since December 2021, after serving as Chief Legal Officer from March 2017. Previously served as Chief Legal Officer and Senior Vice President, IP Licensing at SanDisk Corporation from 2014 until its acquisition in 2016.
people.quote: Mark D. Brazeal has served as our Chief Legal and Corporate Affairs Officer since December 2021.

people.name: Charlie B. Kawwas, Ph.D.
people.title: President, Semiconductor Solutions Group
people.bio: Has served as President, Semiconductor Solutions Group since July 2022, after serving as Chief Operating Officer and in senior sales leadership roles. Previously headed worldwide sales at LSI Corporation from 2010 until its acquisition in 2014.
people.quote: Charlie B. Kawwas, Ph.D. has served as our President, Semiconductor Solutions Group since July 2022.

people.name: Diane M. Bryant
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Serves on the Compensation Committee and has never been an officer or employee of Broadcom.
people.quote: The members of the Compensation Committee, Ms. Bryant and Messrs. Hartenstein, Low and You, are not and have never been officers or employees of Broadcom.

people.name: Gayla J. Delly
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chairs the Audit Committee and serves on the NCG and Executive Committees. The Board has determined that she is an audit committee financial expert.
people.quote: Our Board has determined that Mses. Delly and Page and Mr. You are audit committee financial experts under applicable SEC rules

people.name: Kenneth Y. Hao
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves on the Board and is currently not appointed to any committee.
people.quote: Mr. Hao is currently not appointed to any committee.

people.name: Eddy W. Hartenstein
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Serves as Lead Independent Director and chairs the NCG Committee. He will serve as a director until the Annual Meeting.
people.quote: Our Board has determined that Mr. Hartenstein, who will serve as a director until the Annual Meeting, is also an "independent" director.

people.name: Check Kian Low
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as a founding partner and director of NewSmith Capital Partners LLP since 2003, managing its Asia Pacific offices. He has been an owner and director of Cluny Capital Limited since 2007.
people.quote: Mr. Low has served as a founding partner and director of NewSmith Capital Partners LLP

people.name: Justine F. Page
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Vice President of Finance, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary of Integrated Circuit Systems from 1999 until its acquisition in 2005. Previously served as a director of Broadcom Limited and Avago Technologies Limited.
people.quote: Ms. Page served as Vice President of Finance, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary of Integrated Circuit Systems, Inc.

people.name: Henry Samueli, Ph.D.
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Co-founded Broadcom Corporation in 1991 and served as Broadcom's Chief Technical Officer from February 2016 to December 2018. Has served as Chairman of the Board since 2018.
people.quote: Dr. Samueli served as our Chief Technical Officer from February 2016 to December 2018.

people.name: Hock E. Tan
people.title: President & CEO; Director
people.bio: Has served as Broadcom's President and CEO since March 2006. Previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Integrated Circuit Systems from 1999 until its acquisition in 2005.
people.quote: Mr. Tan has served as our President and CEO since March 2006.

credit.author: Greg Bezat, d/b/a Bezat Video Group

people.name: Harry L. You
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Previously served as Chief Financial Officer and President of GTY Technology Holdings and as Executive Vice President in the Office of the Chairman of EMC Corporation. Also served as Chief Executive Officer of BearingPoint and Chief Financial Officer of Oracle.
people.quote: Mr. You serves as Chairman of the Board of Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco, Inc.
